name: com.tencent.timpush.huawei.HUAWEIHmsMessageService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Huawei messaging adapter receives Huawei push events. It reports new or failed Huawei tokens to Tencent Cloud IM and records message and delivery status.
disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Huawei token updates through this service, so Huawei offline-push registration stops refreshing.
